title: Timing and retry decorators
description:
Write two decorators and use them together.

```
attempt 1 failed: not yet
attempt 2 failed: not yet
fetch took 0.0s
fetch returned 'data'
```
hints: `retry(3)` must return the real decorator, so there are three nested functions: `retry`, `decorate` and `wrapper` (lesson 7.01).
In the wrapper, loop `for attempt in range(1, times + 1)` with `try: return func(*args, **kwargs)`, and in the `except`, `raise` again when `attempt == times`.
requirements: `@timed` prints how long the call took (one decimal) and returns the result.
`@retry(times)` calls the function again when it raises, up to `times` attempts, printing each failure; after the last one it raises the error again.
stretch: Add a `delay` argument to `retry` that waits a little longer before each attempt.
